output_list.reason: The 'Typo Constructor' vulnerability is present in the 'mintToken' function. The function's name 'mintToken' is very similar to 'minting' and 'minting process' in the natural language, attackers can create an unstoppable digital asset (aka 'The Rig Attack') in the output value of the transfer function, allowing the attacker to steal bitcoins from any user and then withdraw them to a stolen output value.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the last line of the function is executed: balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value; balanceOf[_to] += _value; a situation of overflow may occur if the balance of the sender is less than the value being transferred and nothing is returned.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the 2nd last line of the function is executed: allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value; a situation of overflow may occur if the allowance of the from is less than the value being transferred and nothing is returned.

The 'buy' function has a wrong logic in it. The function divides the amount with buyPrice, a vulnerability in integer division, attackers can exploit it to cause a denial of service (DoS) in the system.

The 'sell' function has a wrong logic in it. The function divides the amount with sellPrice, a vulnerability in integer division, attackers can exploit it to cause a denial of service (DoS) in the system.
